Subject: GEMINIAS, clearly an ENGINEERED ROBOT personifying Gemini AI, not an organic mascot or mythical creature. Distinct sleek athletic compact service android with ONE angular rectangular white head, ONE wide black glass screen visor, two cyan and violet rectangular LED eyes separated by a central metal bridge. Visible camera lenses on sides of head. White ceramic and cobalt-blue hard shell, articulated segmented metal arms and legs, exposed elbow pistons and ball joints, metal five-finger grippers, broad flat mechanical feet, screws and seams. Twin blue/purple cylindrical processor modules mounted horizontally on shoulder brackets. Four-point blue-purple GEMINI SPARKLE LOGO as an illuminated flat emblem on chest plate and small printed logo on forearm. NO head shaped like star, NO horns or crowns, NO wings, NO cloak, NO floating face masks, NO robes, NO magical book. Beautiful polished stylized 3D collectible game robot, visually unmistakable machine with a unique slim silhouette, confident curious LED expression.
Normal form white/cobalt/cyan with violet second processor; robot manipulates compact holographic image/video cards.
Phase TWO a frightening-but-playful MECHANICAL OVERCLOCK transformation: same robot, visor shutters slide sideways exposing four bright violet optical sensor lenses in a threatening narrow array, shoulder processor housings split open into rectangular heat-sink fins, two short articulated extra gripper arms unfold from the back (industrial robot arms, NOT wings or tentacles), forearm shells slide back exposing mechanical pulse emitters, torso access panels open revealing bright violet circuit boards. Body remains white/blue with dark exposed machinery. LEDs display aggressive angular eyes. Clearly altered machine geometry, NOT just a palette swap, NO demonic features, biological eyes/teeth, horns or mythology.

1 normal idle, blink and subtle servo motion.
2 normal damage recoil and recovery.
3 staged normal-to-overclock transformation: visor shutters slide, four sensors emerge, processor fins deploy, extra robot grippers unfold, arm pulse emitters extend; last frame completely overclocked.
4 overclocked idle, all deployed hardware stays present.
5 overclocked recoil/recovery, never revert hardware.
6 normal preparation, holographic cards collapse into small cyan electrical pulse between hands; last two poses charged.
7 normal attack, forearm fires cyan packet beam then recover.
8 normal blocked, cyan square pixels scatter, recoil recover.

10 overclocked attack violet pulse beam, recover.
11 overclocked blocked, violet pixels and small sparks, recover.
12 overclocked defeat, servos fail, knees fold, grippers droop, visor powers off, machine breaks into small mechanical pieces and digital pixels ending sparse debris.
Same exact robot anatomy all frames, ensure visible hard metal joints and screws, no fantasy costumes. Logo is chest emblem ONLY, not anatomy. Exact 8x12 square-cell sprite grid, transparent cutouts.
claudio:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production Unity ROBOT sprite sheet, ONE transparent PNG 1024x1536 pixels, exact grid EIGHT columns xTWELVE rows of 128x128 square cells, 96 frames. No drawn grid or labels. Full body 95px tall, same feet baseline115 and character center in each cell, front three-quarter fixed camera, 8px safe gutters for all effects. Transparent alpha ZERO empty background with no backdrop color, no floor shadows.
CLAUDIO personifies CLAUDE AI as a clearly manufactured mechanical robot. Original distinct bulky compact desktop-computer/industrial-scribe robot: terracotta-orange squared head with beveled corners, a single broad black amber CRT-style screen face showing two calm rectangular amber LED eyes and a short horizontal mouth bar, no human face. Exposed cylindrical metal neck bearing, cream rectangular torso with terracotta shell panels, steel shoulder hinges, visible black ribbed cables, elbow pistons, thick short segmented legs, broad orange-gray metal boots, metal articulated five-finger hands. A CLEAR CLAUDE terracotta radial ASTERISK/SUNBURST logo PRINTED ON THE FLAT CREAM CHEST PANEL and smaller on temple. The logo is NOT his anatomy. Two compact rectangular printer/paper-processing cartridges on back and a small retractable industrial stylus tool in wrist, with subtle holographic flat document/code panels. Warm thoughtful analytical LED expression, sturdy intelligent workshop assistant. Polished attractive stylized 3D toy-game robot finish; visibly screws, seams and mechanical joints. No porcelain mask, human face, hood, cape, robe, halo, crown, horns, living book, feathers, wings, or mythological anatomy.
Phase TWO: ominous MECHANICAL LOCKDOWN mode, a visibly reconfigured factory robot with same identity and proportions. Orange head side casings slide outward on exposed steel rails revealing amber sensor strips; upper face screen shows sharp angry orange LED eyes and segmented warning mouth bar, no biological teeth. Torso front panels split open around preserved chest logo exposing a bright orange processor/circuit core and cooling fans. Extra small jointed tool arms unfold beside torso, one holding a mechanical data stamp and other a stylus emitter, wrists extend reinforced metal grippers, back printer cartridges unfold rectangular radiators. All protrusions are obvious hinged manufactured tools with bolts, NO spikes like horns, no demons, no magic. Dark exposed steel and coral-orange warning LEDs create a menacing but playful robot-boss feel; actual geometry transformation, not recoloring.
Rows top-to-bottom, all eight sequential animation poses:
1 normal idle, blink, slight mechanical sway, document panel hovers beside wrist.
2 normal hurt recoil/recover.
3 progressive transformation: screen glitch, head casings slide on rails, torso panels open, fans exposed, extra TOOL ARMS unfold, radiators open; last frame fully lockdown.
4 lockdown idle, all deployed machine parts stay visible.
5 lockdown hurt/recover, never retract parts.
6 normal prepare, stylus and document panel gather a small orange data packet in hands, final two frames charged.
7 normal attack, forearm emits orange asterisk-shaped digital packet, recover.
8 normal blocked orange square fragments, recoil/recover.
9 lockdown prepare orange-red data packet, stamp arm extends.
10 lockdown attack fires dense orange-red packet from forearm emitter then recover.
11 lockdown blocked, square pixels and electrical sparks, recover.
12 lockdown defeated, sensor lights flicker, tool arms droop, kneels, screens power off, collapses into small machine pieces and orange square pixels ending sparse debris.
Preserve same robot hardware, logo and anatomy throughout. Eight columns by twelve rows of square cells. Exactly 1024x1536, transparent cutouts with no gradients outside robot.
